# 🔄 SideShift

> **Category**: `Crypto Swaps`  
> **Official Vendor API Docs**: [https://docs.sideshift.ai](https://docs.sideshift.ai)

Instant cross-chain cryptocurrency exchange and DEX aggregator with fixed and variable rate swaps.
